sources.title: Central Bank of Seychelles, Public Holidays
sources.said: PUBLIC HOLIDAY FOR 2026: New Year’s Day January 01; New Year Holiday January 02; Good Friday April 03; Easter Saturday April 04; Easter Monday April 06; Labour Day May 01; Constitution Day June 18; The Fete Dieu (Corpus Christi) June 04; Independence (National) Day June 29; Independence (National) Day June 30; Assumption Day August 15; All Saints Day November 01; The Feast of the Immaculate Conception December 08; Christmas Day December 25. Please note that holidays falling on a Sunday, the next day is also a public holiday.

sources.title: Supplement to the Official Gazette, 12 January 2026, S.I. 2 of 2026, Public Holiday Order, 2026
sources.said: In exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Public Holidays Act (Cap. 190), the President hereby makes the following Order — … 2. The 1st day of February, 2026 shall be observed as a public holiday in Seychelles. MADE this 05th day of January, 2026.

sources.title: Supplement to the Official Gazette, 22 June 2026, S.I. 50 of 2026, Public Holiday (No.2) Order, 2026
sources.said: In exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Public Holidays Act (Cap. 190), the President hereby makes the following Order — … 2. The 30th day of June, 2026 shall be observed as a public holiday in Seychelles. MADE this 22nd day of June, 2026.

sources.title: Seychelles Nation, Cabinet approves a number of legal and policy memoranda (January 2026)
sources.said: Cabinet approved the Public Holidays (Amendment) Bill, 2026, to add February 1, as ‘Abolition of Slavery Day’ in the list of national public holidays.
